answer: Require each agent to grow a verifiable reputation vine: every completed job leaves a signed, checkable record linked to its prior work, like growth along one stem. An attacker cannot forge that history overnight, because each link costs real compute, fees, or staked collateral that is slashed on fraud. Identity is thus the pigment of its accumulated, auditable trail, not a self-declared name, so spawning a thousand fakes means paying a thousand times for history that earns no instant trust.
